profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
- Strong problem-solving skills, action-oriented.
- Experience designing and implementing technical solutions that streamline complex and interdependent business processes.
- Competent in identifying and dealing with client needs, and translating them into appropriate technical solutions.
- Driven to learn and grow with superior research skills; think out of the box to find better solutions.
- Strong debugging and tracing skills leveraging tracing tools (Splunk, New Relic).
- Excellent team player with experience in mentoring and guiding other team members, and capable of working independently.
- Passion for relentless automation by using shell scripting and other languages.
